label: Accessible witness preservation rules out being without a source of dependence
meaning: Re-presentation at the same origin, not independent support for 000e1f65 (#2103). If a dependent effect could exist without its source, realization gives an accessible contrast witness. Preservation supplies a selected accessible contrast witness for the same pair. Dependence soundness excludes the effect there, contradicting its presence. This uses only witness preservation alongside the original realization and soundness premises. With the selector a free parameter, soundness and preservation hold for some selector exactly when 000e1f65 holds with being-without read as accessible contrast, CAN_BE_WITHOUT_1 (Lean track_preserve_iff_strict), so the warrant is that of the accessibility reading plus the realization bridge 11dc5069. The frontier counts the derivation as proving 000e1f65 from open premises; that records no further warrant.
